note: Files: S3 r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl (500 rows, 1 per problem, 27 cap hits) and S3 r3/base-01/out/F_math500.jsonl (500 rows, all sample 0, 119 cap hits), fetched to runs/theory-tests/r3-across-2/. Keeps rows with cap_hit exactly False, counts case-sensitive \b(Wait|Hmm)\b in the text field, rate = matches / characters x 10,000 pooled per file, ratio T1/F. The text field in both files starts with the rest of the cue (' line!...'), so the cue prefill is part of the characters counted; it is short and the same in both files. n = the smaller kept group (F, about 381 rows). Bootstrap resamples the problem set (union of problem_index across both files), each entry carrying that problem's kept rows from both files. Ambiguity: whether the two pools should cover the same problems. Main reading pools each file's own finished rows (literal); alt_measured restricts to problems finished in both files. Under the main reading the T 0.6 pool drops the 119 looping problems, which tend to be harder and longer, so the two pools cover different problem mixes.

Files: S3 r4/modal_t2-01/t2/T2.jsonl (RL plain T 1.0, 500 rows) and S3 next_n13/s3gate-03/out/rl/rl/math500/generations.jsonl. The n13 file returned 403 Forbidden when fetched while preparing (the inventory also lists it as AccessDenied), so the script will most likely print not_computable; it retries the fetch at run time and computes only if the file becomes readable. If it does, the script needs a 'text' field in the n13 rows (not_computable otherwise; no other field is substituted). It pools all rows of both files with no cap filter. Problems are matched by problem_index, or by unique_id if n13 carries only that, for the bootstrap. alt_measured (computed only if n13 has several rows per problem) keeps one n13 row per problem (sample 0, or the first row). Possible error: I never saw the n13 format; if n13 text includes the prompt or chat template, the character count gets bigger and the rate smaller.

Files: S3 r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl (base cue, a = 0, 27 cap hits), iterate-runs abaybektursun-1114-153102-b029/answers.jsonl (theta0.25_cue per studies/rlneurons/README.md day1_wdiff table, 13 cap hits) and abaybektursun-1114-153110-e985/answers.jsonl (rl_cue, 8 cap hits), fetched to runs/theory-tests/r3-across-2/. One row per problem_index, keeping the highest attempt (all are attempt 0 or have no attempt field, so dedup changes nothing). Keeps cap_hit False, pools rate = \b(Wait|Hmm)\b matches / characters x 10,000 per file, statistic (rate_q - rate_0) / (rate_1 - rate_0). Bootstrap over the union of problems, each entry a triple of kept rows (None where a row was dropped). n = the smallest kept group (T1, about 473). Ambiguity: the main reading pools each file's own finished rows; alt_measured restricts to problems finished in all three. The fraction is unstable if rate(rl_cue) is close to rate(T1): a small denominator widens the interval and can flip the sign. If the denominator is negative the fraction is still reported as written. T1 is a different run (seed 41,000,000 + i) from the day1_wdiff arms; this matches the recipe.
